faqs.question: When was the Nothing Phone 4b launched?
faqs.answer: Nothing officially revealed Phone 4b on 7 July 2026. The reveal is complete, so pages that still describe July 7 as a future announcement are outdated.

faqs.question: What time was the Phone 4b July 7 reveal in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Nothing announced 11:00 BST, equivalent to 3:00 PM Pakistan Standard Time on 7 July 2026.

faqs.question: When did Nothing Phone 4b go on sale?
faqs.answer: Nothing's community announcement described pre-orders after launch and a global open sale on 17 July 2026, while individual markets and special editions had their own dates and channels.

faqs.question: What is the Nothing Phone 4b launch date in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: The global reveal occurred on July 7, but a global reveal date is not proof of a Pakistan retail launch. Confirm current identified local stock, seller, PTA status, warranty and delivery rather than relying on an expected date.

faqs.question: Is Nothing Phone 4b available in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Availability should be confirmed from a live offer for an identified regional unit. Imported listings can appear before an organised local retail launch and may differ in PTA status and warranty.

faqs.question: Was July 17 the Pakistan release date?
faqs.answer: July 17 was reported as the global open-sale date, not automatically a Pakistan retail date. Shipping, importing, registration and local distribution can create a separate timeline.

faqs.question: Which Phone 4b colours launched?
faqs.answer: Nothing lists Black, White and Blue, with Blue identified as web-exclusive in the detailed specification. Local stock may not include every colour.

faqs.question: Did Phone 4b launch with a 6,000 mAh battery?
faqs.answer: The India model lists 6,000 mAh, while the international model lists 5,200 mAh. Launch coverage must identify the region instead of presenting the India number as universal.

faqs.question: Was the red RCB Phone 4b launched globally?
faqs.answer: No. The RCB Limited Edition was an India-exclusive special drop associated with Bengaluru and should not be treated as a standard global or Pakistan colour.

faqs.question: Does a Pakistan Phone 4b listing mean it is PTA approved?
faqs.answer: No. Verify both genuine IMEIs of the exact device through a current official PTA or DIRBS route. Availability and registration are separate facts.

faqs.question: Should Pakistan buyers wait for official local stock?
faqs.answer: Wait if available imports lack a verifiable region, both-IMEI PTA status, written warranty, return terms or a reasonable total price. Buy only when the complete offer is clear.

faqs.question: Where should I check current Phone 4b availability?
faqs.answer: Use the live Nothing Pakistan Phone 4b product page and confirm the exact stock, price, region, PTA status, warranty and delivery terms before ordering.
